title: MFTCXplain: A Multilingual Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating the Moral Reasoning of LLMs through Multi-hop Hate Speech Explanation
reasoning: The paper introduces MFTCXplain, a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the moral reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models. It utilizes Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) as the core framework for annotating and assessing moral sentiments and rationales within hate speech, specifically focusing on ethical dimensions such as care/harm, fairness/cheating, and purity/degradation.
